reason: I always forget pills at home when I travel, and a sachet I can toss in my gym bag fixes that. $24.99 launch price for a first box is low enough to just try it, and the named lab report helps.
objection: It is still two capsules every day, and I might not stick with it. I am not sure I would feel anything, so I will not pay full price for a second box until I know it works for me.
